T24.note: Implemented fresh by the orchestrator: a global daily Google Places call budget and an emergency kill switch (GOOGLE_PLACES_KILL_SWITCH, GOOGLE_PLACES_DAILY_CALL_LIMIT) enforced in PlacesService before every outbound call (discovery/autocomplete/resolve) and in T23's refresh-place-candidates.ts script. Restricted-key setup, Cloud Console quotas, billing alerts and existing dedup (T17's place_id unique index, T23's report-tag dedup) documented in docs/google-places-controls.md rather than implemented, since that part of the task's scope is infrastructure configuration outside this repo. CodeRabbit found and this fixed 4 real issues across three rounds, all the same class of bug: assertGoogleCallAllowed() consuming the shared daily budget before checking GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY in googleAutocomplete, searchGooglePlaces and resolvePlace (a no-key request drained the budget with zero outbound calls), plus an expected kill-switch/budget rejection being logged as an unexpected failure in autocomplete()'s catch handler. Merged 2026-09-29 as 757a26c. Could not run pnpm typecheck/lint/format in this environment (pnpm not installed, no node_modules) — flagged in the PR; CI covered it.

T14.note: Per AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, this task calls for escalating to a stronger model given account-deletion correctness; owner explicitly chose to continue on Sonnet 5 instead (see docs/orchestration-log.md). Implemented DELETE /v1/me: no new migration needed, every profiles.id-referencing table already had the right on-delete rule (cascade to hard-delete reviews/favorites/media_uploads, set null to anonymize spot/taco proposal authorship, moderation audit, report authorship, approved_by/verified_by) from prior migrations. Also batched Storage photo deletion (1,000/batch) and corrected an inaccurate privacy.md claim about token revocation. Declined to add an integration test per CLAUDE.md's no-tests-unless-requested rule; that one thread stays open. Not exercised against a live Supabase/Postgres stack in this environment — the highest-risk gap in this PR, flagged there.

T26.note: Implemented by a delegated Haiku 4.5 worker (orchestrator supervised: prepared worktree, reviewed every diff by hand, wrote the fix-delegation prompts). Custom round marker (View+emoji) replacing default react-native-maps pins; tap opens an Animated.View slide-up bottom sheet (no new dependency) showing name/neighborhood/best taco/review snippet from GET /v1/spots/:id, with an in-memory cache. Went through 4 review rounds with CodeRabbit, catching real bugs each time: (1) worker's first pass used a nonexistent `review.text` field (real field is `body`) and picked 'best taco' as tacos[0] which the API sorts alphabetically, not by score - orchestrator caught both before requesting review; (2) CodeRabbit found a stale-response/animation race + missing marker accessibilityLabel - fixed, but the fix itself had a classic React closure bug (comparing against state captured at callback-creation time instead of current value) that the orchestrator caught by reading the diff, fixed with a synced ref; (3) CodeRabbit found a double-close re-entrance edge case - added a closingRef guard; (4) CodeRabbit found the best-taco lookup silently failed when the spot scrolled out of the loaded items list - added a fallback that computes best-by-score from the detail response instead of just tacos[0]. Merged 2026-09-29 as a7df5f7.
